name: Funan
summary: Generally considered the first known kingdom in Southeast Asia: a network of Indianised states around the Mekong delta that traded between India and China.

location.value: Parts of present-day Cambodia, Thailand and Vietnam, around the lower Mekong.

terrain.value: The low, flooded Mekong delta and the coast of the Gulf of Thailand.
terrain.source: Coedès, The Indianized States of Southeast Asia (1968)
